infrastructure._release: 4.1.0: natural-language routing (session-start loads routing.json; preferences manages phrases); standards.md retired into CLAUDE.md, runtime-reference.md and admin-distribution.md; permission-changes verify accepts inherited access from an earlier row (finding 93). 4.0.1: OneDrive upgrade fixes (org files read by path on OneDrive, publish-updates enforces the 3-to-4 gate, retired capabilities are removed on member update, invite resolves identity first) plus the post-4.0 backlog; pairs with onedrive adapter 2.7.1. 4.0.0 (MAJOR): removes the permission-change-helper; every permission change goes through the core permission-changes procedure. Before publishing, every installed collection must be at its permission-changes release (upgrade/3-to-4.md). 3.x is supported until 2027-01-31.
infrastructure.name: agent-index-core
infrastructure.description: The foundational collection: session bootstrap, member management, org configuration, capability authoring, update orchestration, and the canonical CLAUDE.md template. Required for every agent-index install.
infrastructure.author: agent-index

infrastructure._release: 2.22.3: standards.md citations re-pointed (no behaviour change). 2.22.2: OneDrive code-folder rows by path, one update entry may carry a provider op, no /shared/dist republish outside a publish, dotfile skip-list. 2.22.1: upgrade-collection writes update-log entries with operations[] (members receive same-version collection changes); install-collection refuses collections that still use the removed permission helper and never resets seed data on Reconfigure. 2.22.0: install-collection provisions collection access through the core permission-changes procedure (admin confirms the exact changes, no helper binary) and accepts the legacy grants[] key; requires core 3.32.0.
infrastructure.name: agent-index-marketplace
infrastructure.description: The marketplace integration collection: discover, download, and install marketplace collections; check for updates across all installed pieces; refresh the marketplace cache.
infrastructure.author: agent-index
